title: YouTube AdFree
appDescription: GTV development build of YouTube AdFree, built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3. DEV revision 8 includes the revision 7 standalone isAdPlayback experiment, moves the Remove Shorts JSON.parse hook ahead of app_api to close the same fresh-launch timing window already fixed for ad blocking, and upgrades the on-TV report to diagnostics v5. The Shorts diagnostics count known removals and safely inventory Shorts/reel schema clues found in array entries that survived the conservative classifier, without retaining titles, tracking values, URLs, tokens, or arbitrary payload strings.
